camel_example: aliyun iot CreateEdgeDriver --region cn-hangzhou --DriverProtocol customize --Runtime c --DriverName MyLedDriver
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-edge-driver --driver-name MyLedDriver --driver-protocol customize --runtime c --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEdgeDriver

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The driver name. The name can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). It must start with a letter and cannot exceed 20 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 驱动名称。支持大小写英文字母、数字和下划线（_），必须以英文字母开头，不超过20个字符
parameters.name: driver_name

parameters.help_en:
The communication protocol of the driver. Valid values:

modbus: Modbus protocol.
opc-ua: OPC Unified Architecture protocol.
customize: custom protocol
parameters.help_zh:
驱动通信协议。取值如下：

modbus：Modbus通信协议。
opc-ua：OPC UA通信协议。
customize：自定义通信协议
parameters.name: driver_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the driver. Valid values:

nodejs8: Node.js v8
python3: Python v3.5
c: C language
parameters.help_zh:
驱动的语言类型。支持如下三种类型：

nodejs8：Node.js v8
python3：Python v3.5
c: C语言
parameters.name: runtime

parameters.help_en:
The CPU architecture to which the driver is adapted. Valid values:

armv7
armv7-hf
aarch64
x86-64
x86
parameters.help_zh:
驱动适配的CPU架构。取值如下：

armv7
armv7-hf
aarch64
x86-64
x86
parameters.name: cpu_arch

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the driver is a built-in driver.

true: The driver is a built-in driver, which means the driver code is pre-installed on the gateway.
false: The driver is not a built-in driver. You must upload the driver code. Default value: false.

    > You must upload the driver code for non-built-in drivers. To upload driver code by using an API operation and obtain an Object Storage Service (OSS) address, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155858.html operation to create a pre-signed URL, and then use the OSS SDK to upload the driver file
parameters.help_zh:
是否内置驱动文件。

true：表示驱动为内置驱动，即驱动代码已预置到网关上。
false：表示驱动为非内置驱动。 非内置驱动必须上传驱动代码。默认为false。

    > 非内置驱动必须上传驱动代码。如需通过API的方式上传驱动代码并获取阿里云对象存储（OSS）地址，请调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155858.html接口创建预签名地址后，使用OSS SDK上传驱动文件
parameters.name: is_built_in

Code.description_en: The response code. Success indicates success. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
